label: Strata 0.1.52 | UD-IQ4_XS | NVMe | Control preset 262k, 2 reps
notes:
Reference Strata result on this machine: the run measured with images on. It also had an 8 GiB prefix cache. A tuned configuration with the prefix cache and images off was faster (prefill 1375-1691 tok/s at 40k-200k, decode 30-33 tok/s); see docs/engine-tuning-two-5070-ti.md.

Strata 0.1.52 via Strata Control gateway, model storage on the Samsung 990 PRO NVMe, user's preset: Expert RAM auto (--resident-budget-gib 36.92, pinned 0.00 GiB: page-locking refused), --prefill auto (8192 chunks; 3092 borrowed slots streamed from file every chunk), --conversation-cache-mib 8192, --vision, --spec 4 --spec-min-p 0.5, --kv int8, --max-context 262144, --layer-split auto. Loaded in 112 s. 1:1 NVMe counterpart of Basalt 20261121-205631 and of Strata SATA 20261121-123019.
Hardware: i7-5960X (AVX2), 64 GB DDR4-2133, 2x RTX 5070 Ti 16 GB PCIe 3.0 x16. Protocol: Wattever generic endpoint, 1 query, 256 tokens, temp 0, reasoning none, warmup on, prompts identical to the Basalt runs (cached_prompt_tokens 0).
Finding: storage is decisive for Strata: vs SATA run 20261121-123019, prefill 4-5x faster (1134-1365 vs 230-254 tok/s at 40k-200k) and decode +35% (24-26 vs 18-20), because the 3092 lent prompt slots have no RAM copy and are streamed from the drive on every 8192-token chunk. vs Basalt NVMe 20261121-205631: prefill Strata >= Basalt at >=20k, decode Basalt ~3x.
Metrics (median client values):
  512: prefill 90 tok/s, decode 21.2 tok/s, TTFT 5.8 s (n=2)
  5k: prefill 438 tok/s, decode 24.4 tok/s, TTFT 10.9 s (n=2)
  10k: prefill 515 tok/s, decode 24.3 tok/s, TTFT 18.7 s (n=2)
  20k: prefill 816 tok/s, decode 25.6 tok/s, TTFT 23.9 s (n=2)
  40k: prefill 1134 tok/s, decode 25.9 tok/s, TTFT 35.4 s (n=2)
  80k: prefill 1276 tok/s, decode 25.4 tok/s, TTFT 63.4 s (n=2)
  100k: prefill 1236 tok/s, decode 25.8 tok/s, TTFT 80.7 s (n=2)
  150k: prefill 1335 tok/s, decode 26.3 tok/s, TTFT 112.5 s (n=2)
  200k: prefill 1365 tok/s, decode 24.6 tok/s, TTFT 146.5 s (n=2)

collection.policy: Read-only allow-listed OS/driver probes without elevation; no unique device IDs, host names, network addresses or user paths.

channel_topology.note: Populated channels inferred from explicit firmware channel/slot labels, not DIMM count. Active controller mode is unverified.

memory.note: Channel topology includes its source and detection method; populated channels do not verify active controller mode. Module count does not establish channels. Clocks are firmware/OS reports; measured transfer probes are stored separately.

pcie.maximum_scope: driver-reported platform/adapter limit; physical slot wiring and card lane capability are unverified
pcie.note: Snapshot may show an idle downshift. Reported maxima can reflect platform limits and do not prove the card or physical slot supports that lane count. Encoding ceiling excludes packet/system overhead and is not measured transfer bandwidth.

capabilities.note: No FLOPS/TOPS or device-memory bandwidth measurement was performed. Model quantization bit width is not hardware arithmetic precision; peak compute also depends on operation, clock and sparsity.
